name: qa-mcp-server
description: Open-source MCP server that gives AI agents the QA lead's job: test strategy, quality gates, test execution (Playwright, Cypress), flaky triage and release readiness as typed capabilities, with judgments backed by evidence, deterministic guardrails and a replayable trace.
author: Adama Ouedraogo

scripts.test: node --import tsx --test src/*.test.ts src/tools/*.test.ts src/execution/*.test.ts src/utils/*.test.ts src/capabilities/*/tests/*.test.ts
